# Remove todo stubs from learn/tree.json and dissolve Specific Features group

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 2 (`nav-stubs`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

A developer evaluating the engine clicks through the `Guides` and `Tutorials` sections of `learn/tree.json` and hits three placeholder `"todo"` files and a fragmented `"Specific Applications/Features"` group:
- `learn/guides/specificfeatures/MultiWindow.md` (`34 B`, body is literally `"todo"`) while ten production-grade multi-window dock-layout guides (`236 KB`, Sep–Oct 2026) sit two groups up under `"UI Building Blocks"` and [`learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md) covers the `SharedWorker` architecture.
- `learn/guides/specificfeatures/Mixins.md` (`15 B`, `"todo"`).
- `learn/tutorials/RSP.md` (`49 B`, `"todo"`).
- The `learn/tree.json` group `"Specific Applications/Features"` (`specificfeatures`) holds only the two `"todo"` stubs, `ComponentMatrix.md`, and `PortalApp.md` (easter eggs). None of the three stubs are ranked in `buildScripts/docs/seo/priorities.json`.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 2 `nav-stubs`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §0.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/tree.json` drives both the Portal navigation tree (`apps/portal/view/learn/TreeList.mjs`) and the Knowledge Base guide ingestion (`neo-mjs-knowledge-base`).
- Leaving `"todo"` stubs in `learn/tree.json` exposes empty pages to human evaluators and pollutes Knowledge Base retrieval chunks.
- `learn/guides/specificfeatures/ComponentMatrix.md` belongs under `"UI Building Blocks"` (`uibuildingblocks`), and `learn/guides/specificfeatures/PortalApp.md` belongs under `"Advanced"` (`advanced`).

## The Fix

1. Remove the three `"todo"` stub entries (`guides/specificfeatures/MultiWindow`, `guides/specificfeatures/Mixins`, and `tutorials/RSP`) from `learn/tree.json`.
2. Dissolve the `"Specific Applications/Features"` (`guides/specificfeatures`) group in `learn/tree.json`:
   - Move `ComponentMatrix` (`guides/specificfeatures/ComponentMatrix.md`) into `"UI Building Blocks"` (`guides/uibuildingblocks`) in `learn/tree.json` (keeping the file path or updating `tree.json`'s `id` so links resolve).
   - Move `PortalApp` (`guides/specificfeatures/PortalApp.md`) into `"Advanced"` (`guides/advanced`) in `learn/tree.json`.
3. Ensure multi-window navigation questions route to the 10-part dock-layout guide series (`learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayouts*.md`) and `learn/benefits/body/MultiWindow.md`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/tree.json` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 2 | Remove `MultiWindow`, `Mixins`, and `RSP` `"todo"` stubs from `learn/tree.json`; dissolve `"Specific Applications/Features"` group and relocate `ComponentMatrix` (to `"UI Building Blocks"`) and `PortalApp` (to `"Advanced"`) | Keep or clean up stub `.md` files only after confirming zero inbound relative links via `check-relative-links.mjs` | `learn/tree.json` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` + JSON validity check |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `learn/tree.json` no longer contains entries for the `"todo"` stubs `guides/specificfeatures/MultiWindow`, `guides/specificfeatures/Mixins`, or `tutorials/RSP`.
- [ ] **AC-2:** The `"Specific Applications/Features"` group in `learn/tree.json` is dissolved, with `ComponentMatrix` placed under `"UI Building Blocks"` and `PortalApp` placed under `"Advanced"`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt` are not hand-edited (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).

## Out of Scope

Writing new Mixins or RSP guides (separate leaves if needed); hand-editing generated SEO artifacts (`apps/portal/sitemap.xml`, `apps/portal/llms.txt`).

## Avoided Traps

- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).
- Underselling or flattening Neo.mjs's architectural conviction on any touched page (`#20518` guard).
